answer: Every identity must cross a kernel of independent audits before earning consensus weight. To stop clones, each identity locks a relic of 25 POA for 12 epochs, non-transferable, slashed on fabrication. Auditor nodes sample 10% of bonds per epoch. An attacker running N fakes must keep all N bonds alive for the full 12-epoch window while facing rising audit exposure. Cost grows linearly with N plus a compounding slash term. The nadir of rotating auditors ensures no bond can be borrowed, making bulk cloning uneconomic.
